baseline: Working-tree build immediately after the XLSX XML round; includes earlier uncommitted work, not Git HEAD. Saved in tmp/shared-readers-baseline. npm baselines are packed from saved dist and pre-change package metadata; archive CSS is held identical to current because stylesheet changes are outside this round.
scope: Shared format-name inference, ZIP directory indexing, ordered XML to lookup conversion, archive sorting/filtering/keyboard navigation, and excluding maps from core/archive npm packages. No new runtime dependencies or format algorithms in Go.
method: Core/ZIP/format measurements use production ESM builds in Node. Internal XML view uses an esbuild entry with baseline source overrides. Alternating paired runs, 3 warmups and 9 measured runs; full outputs hashed outside timers. Complete PPTX load uses fresh entry modules before timing to reset generated IDs, preserving exact comparison. Browser controls use production archive JS through Vite import resolution, shared current core/CSS, 2 warmups and 7 alternating measured runs. Runtime sizes include every JS/MJS file including worker, compressed per file using Node gzip level 9/default Brotli; exclude dependencies, CSS, maps and WASM. npm sizes include the actual package files and WASM but exclude dependencies.

xml-ordered-and-lookup-20000.includes: tokenization and lookup grouping; no ZIP or byte decoding

pptx-sample-deck.pptx.includes: complete loadPptx model; no rendering or module import; fresh entry module resets generated IDs before each timed invocation

pptx-rich-pptx-shapes.pptx.includes: complete loadPptx model; no rendering or module import; fresh entry module resets generated IDs before each timed invocation

archive.method: Real archive sessions loaded from production JS through Vite import resolution. Alternating old/current implementations, fresh session per iteration. Both share current core and CSS. Input creation, module loading, warmup, DOM/HTML validation and hashing are outside timings. Keyboard events include synchronous event handling and focus; filtering includes full synchronous result DOM rebuilds. No animation-frame or physical paint measurement.

limitations: Generated paths, ZIPs and XML are scoped workloads, not whole application speedups or product rankings. Only two representative PPTX files are timed; one is unchanged.
Keyboard measurements cover 200 synthetic key events and synchronous focus changes, not physical input-to-paint latency. Filtering still rebuilds matching DOM and does not improve consistently.

Initial broad tests failed to start because of disk exhaustion; retried successfully after cargo clean removed 223.8 MiB of regenerable cross-target dependency caches. These failures are not counted as passed tests.

Runtime raw JS grows by 84 bytes; gzip sum shrinks by 97 bytes. The much larger npm package reduction comes mainly from excluding source/declaration maps. Local JS maps are still generated in hidden mode.
No peak-memory, network-transfer, complete preview startup or end-to-end directory search measurement.
